subject.title: [Feature]: Self-hosted STT/TTS provider support in webchat (Route webchat TTS through the gateway instead of browser Speech API)

question: Should WebChat voice be implemented as two reviewed Gateway-backed slices using `messages.tts` and `tools.media.audio`, and should direct browser Web Speech or a new `messages.stt` config surface be rejected for this issue?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the remaining choice affects product UX, microphone privacy, provider routing, and config compatibility, which requires maintainer intent before automation should build another fix.

options.title: Use Gateway-backed slices
options.body: Keep this umbrella open while reviewing the TTS Read aloud and editable dictation PRs separately, with STT routed through `tools.media.audio` and no new `messages.stt` stack.

options.title: Accept browser speech explicitly
options.body: Allow browser Web Speech dictation or synthesis only with visible docs/UI copy explaining that it bypasses configured providers and may use browser/vendor services.

options.title: Supersede into narrower issues
options.body: Close this umbrella only after maintainers designate the narrower TTS and dictation issues/PRs as the canonical remaining work.

recommendation.title: Use Gateway-backed slices
recommendation.body: Keep this umbrella open while reviewing the TTS Read aloud and editable dictation PRs separately, with STT routed through `tools.media.audio` and no new `messages.stt` stack.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current feature-history signal across prior WebChat dictation, current WebChat/media tests, and the open TTS candidate PR.
